spec.title: Client Intake Portal
spec.intent: Prove the Engineering OS can select resources, forge a real app, run QA/build gates, start a runtime, verify the live health/security surface, and capture reusable lessons.

gates.label: Forge emit
gates.command: npx.cmd --yes tsx apps/cli/src/bin/nx.ts forge internal-tool-dashboard client-intake-portal --inputs %USERPROFILE%\nexural-meta\.nexural\cache\golden-path\client-intake-portal-2026-06-01T021207279Z\inputs.json --mock-secrets --out-dir %USERPROFILE%\nexural-meta\.nexural\cache\golden-path\client-intake-portal-2026-06-01T021207279Z\client-intake-portal

gates.label: Standalone lockfile
gates.detail: Generated app includes its own pnpm-lock.yaml for isolated Vercel installs.

gates.label: Verify live local app
gates.command: npx.cmd --yes tsx apps/cli/src/bin/nx.ts verify http://127.0.0.1:3041 --evidence-slug client-intake-portal-local --timeout 20000

reusable_lessons.lesson: Run forge with tsx until recipe input schemas ship compiled JS siblings.
reusable_lessons.fed_back: Captured in golden-path script command path.

reusable_lessons.lesson: Generated Next apps should use top-level typedRoutes and explicit outputFileTracingRoot.
Local runtime proof needs a generated .env.local with safe mock values when using mock secrets.
reusable_lessons.fed_back: Golden-path runner writes staging credentials when configured, otherwise public-safe mock env, and keeps both out of committed artifacts.

remaining_gaps: Runtime proof uses mock credentials because staging Supabase/Auth environment variables are not set in this shell.
Production auth/database credentials are intentionally not committed.
